result.one_liner: Open-source CRM platform with GraphQL and REST APIs for managing contacts, companies, and custom objects with workspace-specific schemas

evidence.quote: with Bearer API key auth and batch operations up to 60 records
Twenty offers REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, and OAuth
Twenty is available both cloud-hosted at twenty.com (with a free tier available) and as a self-hosted option via Docker
Create an API key in Settings → API & Webhooks → + Create key. Copy it immediately — it's shown once
Core API — /rest/ and /graphql/ CRUD on records: People, Companies, Opportunities
Your workspace-specific API documentation is available under Settings → API & Webhooks after creating an API key

result.notes: Twenty is AGPLv3 licensed open-source; free tier available on cloud and self-hosted; API keys self-serve with no approval required. API endpoint count unknown as endpoints are auto-generated per workspace schema. Community MCP server exists but not vendor-official.
